description: List notes and subdirectories at a vault path. Defaults to the vault root when `path` is omitted. Tune recursion with `depth`, or filter the walk with `extension` / `nameRegex`. Capped at 1000 entries per call — when reached, walking stops and `excluded` is set; narrow `path` or tighten filters to surface the rest.

depth.description: How many directory levels to walk. `1` = target directory only (no recursion); `2` = target plus its immediate children — a structural overview; bump higher to drill in. Prefer narrowing `path` to a subdirectory over a high `depth` on the vault root.

extension.description: Only include files matching this extension, with or without leading dot. Applies to files only — directories are returned regardless.

nameRegex.description: Optional ECMAScript regex (no flags, ≤256 chars, no nested quantifiers like `(a+)+`) applied to entry names. Matches both files and directories; directories that fail the regex are skipped without recursing into them.

path.description: Vault-relative directory path. Omit for the vault root.

name: obsidian_list_notes

appliedFilters.description: Active filters and the recursion depth that produced this listing.

depth.description: Recursion depth used to produce this listing.

extension.description: Extension filter applied, normalized with leading dot.

nameRegex.description: nameRegex filter applied to this listing.

entries.description: Entries in DFS order — top-level first, then descendants.

items.description: A single entry in the listing.

truncated.description: On directory entries: true when the depth limit prevented walking into this directory. Pass a deeper `depth` to expand.

type.description: Whether this entry is a regular file or a subdirectory.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `regex_invalid`: The supplied `nameRegex` is not a valid ECMAScript regex. `regex_unsafe`: The supplied `nameRegex` is well-formed but exceeds the 256-character limit or contains nested quantifiers known to cause catastrophic backtracking. `path_forbidden`: The supplied `path` is outside OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS and is not a folder on the way to it. The vault root and the folders leading to a scoped path always list, showing only in-scope entries. `directory_missing`: No listable directory at the supplied `path` — either it does not exist, or it exists and currently holds no files. Sub-directories that disappear mid-walk are silently skipped, so only the root path surfaces this error. `path_is_file`: The supplied `path` names a file rather than a directory. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

excluded.description: Present when the walk was truncated by the global entry cap.

cap.description: The cap value at which walking stopped.

reason.description: `entry_cap`: walk stopped because the per-call entry limit was reached.

notice.description: Guidance when the walk was truncated by the entry cap, or the listed directory is empty.

path.description: The directory listed (empty string for vault root).

entries.description: Total entries returned across all walked depths.

title: Obsidian List Notes
